cost_accounting.qualification: Aggregate execution time, not campaign elapsed time or CPU time. Includes inherited attempts once, interrupted parent attempts, continuation attempts, and excluded preflight. Earlier interactive diagnosis, human effort, setup, and analysis costs are not fully measured.
